welcome.title:
Ask your
files
welcome.lead: You don't have to dig through folders. AutoRAG reads what's inside your documents and answers with sources.
welcome.note: Local by default. When remote processing is needed, we show you exactly what will be sent first.

chat.user: Why did last quarter's costs go down?

hybrid.title: Hybrid search
hybrid.sub: Keywords and meaning together, ordered by reranking

account.title:
Start with
your account
account.lead: Only your plan and trial are tied to your account. Your files and index stay on this Mac.
account.note: You sign in in your browser and come back to this app automatically. You never enter your password in the app.
account.busyNote: You'll return here automatically once authentication finishes.
account.authNote: We'll email you a sign-in link. No file contents are stored in your account.

permissions.title:
Allow access so we
can read properly
permissions.leadMac: macOS asks for your permission before an app can access documents and protected app data. Permissions and indexing scope are different things.
permissions.leadWindows: Just confirm notifications and network and you can start right away. You can change the rest later in Settings.
permissions.note: AutoRAG never modifies your files. You pick exactly which folders to index in the next step.

fda.name: Full Disk Access
fda.desc: Needed for AutoRAG to work properly.

login.name: Launch at login
login.desc: Keeps the index up to date in the background when files change.

network.name: Network (firewall)
network.desc: Needed for cloud embedding and model calls. If the Windows security warning appears on first launch, allow it.

folders.title: Choose the folders AI can read
folders.lead: Only the folders selected here are included in AI search. You can expand or shrink the scope later.
folders.summaryNote: node_modules · .git · files over 50 MiB are excluded automatically.
folders.warning: This scope is broad. Choosing a subfolder or cloud embedding shows your first results sooner.

embedding.title:
Where should we
embed?
embedding.lead: Decide where the work of turning your documents into searchable vectors happens. Changing it later means starting over, which costs more time and money.
embedding.reindexNote: Changing the embedding model or processing location discards the index you've built and starts over from scratch.
embedding.localLead: Your file contents never leave the Mac.
embedding.bulletPower: Recommended to plug in on laptops
embedding.cloudLead: Processes faster, but the contents of the documents you select are sent.

sources.title:
Also search
connected sources?
sources.lead: We only show sources that are already installed and authenticated. You don't have to select them all.
sources.checking: Checking which other sources can be added…
sources.empty: No connected sources found. You can connect some later in Settings.
sources.connectMore: Sources that need setup can be connected later in Settings.

detail.github: Signed in · Issues and Pull Requests

plan.title: How will you use it?
plan.lead: Your plan determines AI usage and where embedding happens. You can change it later in Settings.

indexing.title: AutoRAG is reading your files
indexing.gateOkDetail: We've read all {{files}} files. Newly changed files continue to be read in the background.
indexing.gateFailDetail: Try again and it'll continue where it left off.
indexing.gateTitle: Don't quit AutoRAG or turn off {{machine}}
indexing.gateDetailMac: The first index takes a while. Quitting stops progress. Plug in the power adapter and keep the lid open.
indexing.gateDetailWindows: The first index takes a while. Quitting stops progress. Keep it plugged in.

1.title: One {{shortcut}} to ask right away
1.body: Jumps to the AI Search field from any screen. Ask about what's inside your documents without opening folders, and get answers with sources.

2.title: Tap a number in the answer to preview the source
2.body: The numbers attached to answers are the actual document locations that were read. Tap one to preview the evidence file right there.
2.bubble: Marketing costs fell 18% from the previous quarter.

3.title: Space to skim without opening
3.body: Select a file and press Space to preview it with Quick Look. Check contents without switching apps.

4.title: Drag files into your question
4.body: Drag Finder rows, files from other apps, or folders into AI Search to ask questions scoped to them.

5.title: Group similar files into one
5.body: Similar files like proposal-final and proposal-v3 are grouped and shown as latest, similar, and identical. No more picking the wrong version.

6.title: Find files with {{shortcut}}
6.body: Jumps straight to the search field. Looks at keywords and meaning together and orders them by reranking.

7.title: Switch views with {{shortcut}} · 2 · 3
7.body: Switch between icon, list, and column views by keyboard. The last view you chose is kept on the next launch.

8.title: Slack and GitHub with the same question
8.body: Connected data sources are searched alongside files. You can add or turn off sources anytime in Settings.

9.title: Reconfigure anytime with {{shortcut}}
9.body: Change folder scope, AI model, and data sources in Settings. Changing the embedding location will re-index from scratch.

fda.title: Full Disk Access
fda.heading: Turn it on in System Settings
fda.lead: You only need to allow it once to read macOS protected areas. Onboarding continues from this step even if you quit the app.
fda.step1: Open Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access.
fda.step2: Add AutoRAG to the list and turn on the toggle.
fda.step3: If macOS asks, quit and reopen.
fda.drag: If it's not in the list, drag this icon onto the list

mock.paneLead: The apps below can access files on your entire disk.

restart.title: Reopen AutoRAG?
restart.lead: Full Disk Access takes effect after you quit and reopen the app. Onboarding continues from the current step.

pay.proLead: It's free for 7 days. You won't be billed during the trial and we'll let you know before it ends. Cloud embedding is available as soon as you start the trial.
pay.airLead: You'll be billed $4/mo starting today. You can use managed AI models more generously than Free.
pay.proConsent: I agree to an automatic $20/mo charge when the 7-day free trial ends. I can cancel anytime in Settings.
pay.airConsent: I agree to an automatic $4/mo charge. I can cancel anytime in Settings.
pay.demo: No real payment will occur. This step is a placeholder for QA, and card details are neither stored nor sent.
